title: Stuck at the Wall of Awful?
pin_title: Wall of Awful ADHD: Why Starting Feels Impossible (and a Kinder Way In)
description: The Wall of Awful is the pile-up of past failed attempts, shame and dread that makes even a small task feel impossible. It's not laziness, it's an emotional barrier. Try shrinking the task until it feels almost silly: open the document, write one sentence, set a kind 5-minute timer. Small wins knock bricks out of the wall one at a time. #ADHD #ADHDTips #WallOfAwful #ExecutiveFunction

title: Body Doubling Helps ADHD Brains Start
pin_title: Body Doubling for ADHD: The Quiet Trick That Makes Starting Easier
description: Starting is often the hardest part of ADHD. Working next to someone else, whether a friend at the same table, a study buddy on video or a virtual co-working room, gives your brain the gentle outside nudge it needs to begin. You don't have to talk, quiet company is enough. Try it with your next dreaded to-do. #ADHD #BodyDoubling #ADHDTips #Focus
